settings.text: Brad McDonnell, Resurge founder, on the mats

settings.repere: Paragraphe · BJJ brown belt out of Lemos Jiu-Jitsu, B
settings.text: BJJ brown belt out of Lemos Jiu-Jitsu, Brisbane. The bloke who lost 8–10 weeks off the mats to ringworm and a staph infection.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Like most grapplers, I thought hygiene w
settings.text: Like most grapplers, I thought hygiene was covered. Then I spent those weeks on the couch watching my training partners progress without me.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Tea-tree soap, antibacterial body wash,
settings.text: Tea-tree soap, antibacterial body wash, showering at the gym, “just toughing it out”. None of it was a routine for the gap. So I built one with a specialist chemist in Melbourne.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · GUARD and STRIKE are in my own bag every
settings.text: GUARD and STRIKE are in my own bag every session. Play rough. Stay clean.
